text:
maya: Morning — quick onboarding snag. My hardware security key shipment got delayed (tracking shows ~2‑5 days). Can I register Okta MFA with an Authenticator app temporarily? I need access to GDrive and repos.

it-helpy: Hi Maya — sorry about that. You can use Okta Verify or Google Authenticator as a fallback. I'll open a temporary access ticket for repo writes. What's your GitHub username?

maya: thanks! github: mayal. Also I haven't received the 1Password org invite yet.

people-ops-bot: Checklist note: 1Password invite was sent 2026-02-28 per system logs. Provisioning can be blocked by Google Workspace delays. Pinging IT.

samir: Added temporary 'repo-write' role to mayal for 48h. Okta fallback flow: visit https://redwood.okta.com → Security → Set up MFA → choose 'Authenticator app'. For 1Password, check your email spam folder or use the expiring shared vault link: https://1password.redwood/invite (expires in 6h).

maya: Followed the flow but get an error when scanning the QR: "Device registration failed: 403". Anyone seen that?

jess: 403 often means your Google account hasn't been linked in Okta yet. Try signing out of Okta, click 'Sign in with Google' first, then enroll MFA. If still 403, @samir — can you double-check provisioning?

maya: That worked — signed in via Google first and the QR scan succeeded. One more Q: when the hardware key arrives, should I register it? Can it replace the Authenticator method?

samir: Yes, register the hardware FIDO key under Okta → Security → Add factor → 'Security Key'. It'll be your primary second factor; keep the Authenticator as a backup. Also paste your SSH public key (example: `ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "maya@redwood.com"` then add `~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub`) into the 'Employee SSH keys' Google Doc so we can add it to repo access.

maya: Got it — will add SSH key and register hardware key when it arrives. Thanks everyone! :wave:
